Present attitude toward life

During this time these people are in a frame of mind where they have the energy and enthusiasm to manage larger projects. Opportunity is open to them to take a command position and to get things done on a large scale. Money can be made by their influence and activities but on a personal level, money should not be their objective. Financial rewards come only after the job has been done or the work has been put in to bring about the monetary rewards for their efforts.

A business activity can be built to last a long time if they manage both the people and the infrastructure of the project they are involved with. Risk taking at this time is not advisable unless all angles have been considered and due diligence has been undertaken to a high standard. Any mistakes at this time for them are a costly exercise indeed; not just financially but also by way of their reputation. It is highly likely travel due to business activities will arise and any opportunity in the printing or publishing arenas, or dealing with commercial advertising, is possible and very rewarding for them and their employer.

Matters of a personal nature involving their marriage or relationships are not their main focus at this time. Business matters are always in the forefront of their mind, but it is advisable to maintain a high level of communication with their loved ones or serious problems will arise. An efficient schedule and good financial management are most important at this time for them. They should follow all projects through to the end and keep their hand on the pulse of the work they are in control of. Constant attention must be paid to keeping themselves well balanced, mentally, financially and physically.
